idea-plugin.name: Copy Selection Reference
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin copies a file reference with line numbers to the clipboard for selected text. Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA and WebStorm.
Features: - Copies file path with line numbers (e.g., "src/main/MyFile.java:4-10") - Works with any file type - Uses relative paths from project root - Simple and lightweight - Supports both IntelliJ IDEA and WebStorm
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.1.0: - Added WebStorm compatibility (WS-252.25557.126+) - Updated to support IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ - Updated to Java 17 and Kotlin 1.9.25
Version 1.0.0: - Initial release - Copy file reference with line numbers to clipboard
